title: Industrial Hygiene Specialist

Celebrating Long Service provides an opportunity for the business to demonstrate their appreciation of the hard work, dedication and many years’ services of our employees at 5-year service milestones Job Objectives: Support the Industrial Hygiene Lead in the implementation and continuous improvement of the Industrial Hygiene and Occupational Health programs. The position is responsible for field execution of occupational hygiene activities including anticipation, recognition, evaluation and control of chemical, physical, biological and ergonomic hazards; exposure monitoring; respiratory protection; hygiene inspections; IH equipment management; contractor compliance; technical reporting; and occupational health support. The role provides practical IH support to Business Lines and contractors to ensure occupational health risks are effectively identified, assessed, controlled and documented in accordance with requirements, applicable Iraqi regulations and recognized international standards. IH Risk Assessment, Exposure Monitoring & Control Conduct routine, planned and task-specific IH inspections and occupational exposure assessments across production, maintenance, drilling, projects, logistics, workshops, camps and other activities Perform qualitative and quantitative assessment of chemical, physical, biological and ergonomic hazards and recommend controls using the hierarchy of controls. Support Health Risk Assessments, JSA/PTW reviews, SIMOPS and pre-job planning where occupational health hazards are involved Conduct and document area and personal exposure monitoring for VOC/BTEX, benzene, H2S, CO, SO2, LEL, dust/particulates, noise, heat stress, illumination, NORM/radiation and other agents as required. Perform TWA/STEL or task-based assessments where applicable; compare results with requirements and recognized occupational exposure limits; immediately escalate significant or abnormal findings to the IH Lead. IH Equipment, Sampling & Data Quality Maintain IH instruments and sampling equipment in operational readiness. Perform/coordinate calibration, bump tests, functional checks, preventive maintenance, battery/consumable management and inventory control; maintain traceable calibration and maintenance records. Verify correct sampling methods, instrument configuration and data quality before field use Occupational Hygiene Programs Support implementation of occupational hygiene programs including Respiratory Protection, Hearing Conservation/noise control, Heat Stress Prevention, NORM, chemical exposure control, ergonomics, indoor/workplace environmental quality, food hygiene and drinking-water safety. Conduct kitchen, dining, welfare and camp hygiene inspections; support food/water sampling and follow-up of laboratory results and corrective actions Respiratory Protection, Operational Support & Assurance Support the Respiratory Protection Program: conduct hazard-based respirator selection, quantitative fit testing, user instruction and recordkeeping; verify appropriate filters/cartridges and coordinate medical evaluation/clearance requirements with the MOH medical team. Provide IH technical support for shutdowns, confined-space preparation/entry, vessel cleaning, chemical handling, welding/hot work, waste management, drilling/project activities, occupational exposure incidents and other high-risk work. Conduct follow-up measurements to verify effectiveness of controls and safe continuation of work Review contractor IH plans, procedures, risk assessments, SDS information and monitoring arrangements; participate in joint inspections and compliance verification. Prepare technical survey/assessment reports, maintain exposure and calibration databases, track IH corrective actions and trends, deliver workforce awareness/training, support incident investigations involving occupational exposure, and propose improvements to IH procedures, monitoring technology and control measures to the IH Lead. title: HSE Supervisor
description: Job Description Job title : HSE Supervisor Location : Basra, Iraq Job reference # : 34113 Contract type : Permanent Language requirements : Fluent in English and Arabic; knowledge of Italian is a plus. At Eni , we are looking for an HSE Supervisor to join Eni Iraq B.V. in Basra , Iraq. You will be responsible for ensuring the effective implementation of the Project Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) Management System at site level. Working closely with site management, you will play a key role in promoting a strong safety culture, overseeing daily HSE activities and ensuring compliance with company, client and local regulatory requirements. This is a field-based position requiring a strong on-site presence, proactive safety leadership and the ability to influence safe working behaviours across a multicultural workforce. About Eni Iraq B.V. Eni Iraq B.V. is a leading energy company at the forefront of the exploration, development, and production of hydrocarbons in Iraq. Since 2009, we have been actively involved in the development of the Zubair oil and gas field in the Basra region, which is one of the most significant assets in Eni's global portfolio. This field plays a crucial role in meeting the growing demand for energy and has been a key contributor to both the local economy and the broader energy sector in Iraq. Our commitment to sustainable development extends far beyond energy production. At Eni Iraq, we prioritize creating a positive, lasting impact in the communities where we operate. We invest in local education programs, improve healthcare access, and lead environmental sustainability initiatives to support the long-term development of the Basra region and Iraq as a whole. By joining us, you will be part of a dynamic team that is shaping the future of energy, contributing to innovative solutions, and playing an active role in Iraq's energy sector. Eni Iraq offers you the opportunity to be part of an organization that balances cutting-edge energy development with a strong focus on the well-being of local communities and the environment. Join us and make a real difference, be part of a team that is driving progress, sustainability, and positive change in Iraq and the energy industry worldwide. Main Responsibilities Supervise and coordinate the implementation of HSE plans, procedures and operational performance initiatives across all site activities. Conduct daily site inspections, identify and report unsafe acts and conditions, and ensure appropriate corrective actions are implemented and followed up. Participate in Job Safety Analysis (JSA) and Permit to Work (PTW) reviews before work commences. Monitor compliance with company and client HSE requirements, ensuring appropriate use of PPE and maintaining high housekeeping standards. Lead toolbox talks and safety briefings to promote HSE awareness among employees, contractors and subcontractors. Support investigations into incidents, near misses and unsafe conditions, preparing reports and recommending appropriate preventive measures. Verify the effective implementation of emergency response procedures and drills, taking a leading role in on-site emergency exercises. Coordinate with subcontractors’ HSE representatives to ensure alignment with site safety requirements and standards. Maintain accurate HSE records, including training records, site inspection reports and HSE performance indicators. Support the implementation of environmental controls, including waste segregation, spill prevention and emissions control. Promote continuous improvement and positive HSE behaviours throughout project execution. Encourage and support the use of HSE digital tools to improve site monitoring and reporting. Prepare meeting minutes and HSE reports as required. Promote and communicate the company’s HSE culture effectively to local employees, contractors and subcontractors. Skills And Experience Required Experience working on oil and gas projects. Strong experience in technical safety and HSE management roles. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Environmental Science or a related discipline preferred. Fluency in written and spoken English. Good knowledge of international HSE standards, including OSHA, ISO 45001 and ISO 14001. Experience working in multicultural environments and challenging climatic conditions. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and promote safe working behaviours. Proactive and assertive approach, with the ability to take ownership of site HSE activities. Strong reporting and documentation skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office and HSE databases. Collaborative approach, with a commitment to supporting and mentoring junior colleagues. How To Apply Applications are only accepted through our online application system. Please upload your CV in English. About Eni Eni is a global energy company operating in 61 Countries, with over 30,000 employees. Originally an oil & gas company, it has evolved into an integrated energy company, playing a key role in ensuring energy security and leading the energy transition. Eni's goal is to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050 through the decarbonization of its processes and of the products it sells to its customers. In line with this goal, Eni invests in the research and development of technologies that can accelerate the transition to increasingly sustainable energy. Renewable energy sources, bio-refining, carbon capture and storage are only some examples of Eni's areas of activity and research. In addition, the company is exploring game-changing technologies such as fusion energy – a technology based on the physical processes that power stars and that could generate safe, virtually limitless energy with zero emissions. Working at Eni At Eni we believe in enterprising people, capable of making a difference and making their contribution with passion and innovation, to respond to the global challenges of the energy transition. title: Risk and Safety Section Head
description: Wood is recruiting for a Risk and Safety Section Head to join its Iraq business unit focusing on leading end‑to‑end site risk & safety management for oilfield operations. This role is a full-time on-site role in Basra, Iraq. Work Schedule: 28/28 Rotation #Wood #Iraq #Basra #Risk and Safety Section Head The role This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Risk and Safety Section Head to join our Iraq Business Unit. Our Clients and Projects Designing the future. Transforming the world. Wood is an integral part of operations in Iraq, and we are continuing to grow our footprint across the country. With a 90-year heritage, 10 major contracts and over 850 employees, we have the skills, expertise and asset knowledge to support clients to deliver energy security and decarbonisation ambitions. Wood excels in supporting our clients to deliver complex upstream and midstream oil and gas projects in Iraq delivering maintenance, modifications and engineering solutions. We are committed to decarbonising existing assets, producing cleaner energy and developing a sustainable national workforce, ensuring the long-term growth of the region. What we can offer Meaningful and interesting projects Delivered to high profile clients and complex projects in Iraq Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion ; we are an organisation actively committed to diversity and inclusion across our business with employee networks committed to giving all employees a voice Competitive salary with regular salary reviews to ensure we are rewarding at the right level in line with the market Medical Insurance: Ensures inpatient and outpatient medical care is available should you require treatment. Commitment to continued professional development; development plans that are tailored to your individual needs and interests Global connections : join experts around the world who are at the leading edge of our industry, shaping the standards of our profession Job Purpose: Lead end‑to‑end site risk & safety management for oilfield operations including drilling, site construction, contractor activities and road safety. Supervise safety team, ensure full compliance with safety standards, conduct inspections & incident investigation, drive proactive safety culture and deliver safety improvement initiatives for multi‑facility oilfield sites. Key Functions & Activities: Oilfield Site Safety & Risk Control: Oversee safety operations across diverse oilfield work sites (drilling, construction, scaffolding, field mobile traffic etc.). Conduct site inspections, hazard identification and safety walkthroughs. Enforce compliance with safety procedures and safe work practices. Participate in incident root‑cause investigation and drive closure of corrective actions. Stakeholder & Contractor Safety Management: Supervise safety team performance; mentor staff and support competency development. Closely manage large contractor groups: deliver safety briefings, joint inspections, ensure contractor adherence to corporate safety requirements. Facilitate safety meetings, toolbox talks and safety workshops for site personnel and contractors. Act as backup support for HSE Manager. Team Management: Lead and manage the Risk and Safety Section team, fostering effective teamwork, collaboration, communication, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders to achieve HSE objectives. Audit, Training & Emergency Preparedness: Lead safety audits, hazard hunts and performance monitoring across oilfield operations. Deliver safety inductions, safety campaigns and awareness training including VIP contractor inductions. Support emergency drills and incident response activities, promote continuous safety improvement across the site. Documentation & Reporting: Review and approve critical safety documents including risk assessments, JSAs and work permits. Prepare daily/weekly/monthly safety reports; track incidents, near‑misses, safety observations and safety KPIs. Maintain safety policies aligned with oilfield operational requirements. Qualifications What makes you remarkable? At Wood, we are committed to equal opportunities and welcome all talented individuals to consider joining our team. So even if you don't match every statement below but feel you have some of the experience, knowledge or skills needed for this role, we encourage you to apply. It will take all of us working together to deliver solutions to the world’s most critical challenges. Expected: Education & Knowledge: Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or safety‑related discipline Professional Certifications: Recognized HSE qualification such as NEBOSH, IOSH, CSP/CMIOSH or equivalent is preferred. ISO 45001 / ISO 14001 auditor or lead-auditor qualification and formal incident-investigation / risk-assessment training are desirable. Work Experience: Minimum 10 years safety operation experience, solid oil & gas / on‑shore oilfield or construction background. Proven track record leading safety teams and performing field inspections for complex high‑risk sites. Languages: English: fluent working proficiency. Arabic and/or Chinese language capability is an advantage. Technical Competencies: Good knowledge of international safety standards (ISO45001, OSHA). Strong incident investigation, risk assessment, audit and analytical problem‑solving skills. Excellent team supervision and cross‑party coordination capability. Others Requirements (If any): Ability to manage multi‑discipline safety teams covering drilling, scaffolding and site road safety; capable of working in dynamic high‑risk oilfield operating environment.
